A '''status''' is an effect indicated by a small icon below the [[hull]] on a ship. Player and enemy ships can gain statuses. Statuses last until the end of combat.

==List of statuses==
Note: Although [[Shield]] and [[Temporary Shield]] are like statuses in many ways, the game's logic does not classify them as statuses, so they aren't listed here.

In this list, the value X represents the value of the corresponding status.

|-

| [[File:Ace.png|36x36px]] || Ace || This ship gains X Evade at the start of its turn.

| [[File:AutododgeLeft.png|36x36px]] || Autododge (Left) || Right before this ship would be hit by an attack (including drones, but not missiles), the whole ship moves to one space left of the targeted lane. This status then decreases by 1. Goes away at the start of this ship's turn.
|-
| [[File:AutododgeRight.png|36x36px|]] || Autododge (Right) || Right before this ship would be hit by an attack (including drones, but not missiles), the whole ship moves to one space right of the targeted lane. This status then decreases by 1. Goes away at the start of this ship's turn.
|-
| [[File:Autopilot.png|36x36px]]|| Autopilot|| After playing the leftmost/rightmost card in your hand, your ship moves left/right X spaces. Goes away at the start of this ship's turn.
|-
| [[File:Boost.png|36x36px]]|| Boost || The next time this ship gains any status, it gains X more of it, and Boost is consumed. (This doesn't apply when you ''lose'' any amount of status, even if it is "gaining" a negative amount.)
|-
| [[File:BubbleJuice.png|36x36px]]|| Bubble|| The next [[Midrow Objects|midrow object]] this ship launches gets a Bubble Shield around it. This status then decreases by 1. (If the object natively has a Bubble Shield, this status won't be consumed on it.)
|-

|-

|-

|-
| [[File:EndlessMagazine.png|36x36px]]|| Endless Magazine|| After drawing cards at the start of each turn, draw X [[Chip Shot]]s.

Cards of that character will have no effects when played (energy cost and [[Card Traits|card traits]] are unaffected) and will instead decrease this status by 1. Once the status is depleted to 0, their cards are back to normal.

|-

|-

|-
| [[File:Quarry.png|36x36px]]|| Quarry|| This ship gains X Shard at the start of its turns.
|-
| [[File:TemporaryCheap.png|36x36px]]|| Cheap Fix|| [[Card Traits#Temporary|Temporary]] cards cost X less energy. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
|-
| [[File:ReflexiveCoating.png|36x36px]]|| Reflexive Coating|| When a ship part is hit, it temporarily gains [[Part Traits#Armored|Armor]] until the end of its turn.
|-
| [[File:RockFactory.png|36x36px]]|| Rock Factory|| At the start of its turn, this ship launches X asteroids out of its Missile Bay.
|-
| [[File:Serenity.png|36x36px]]|| Serenity|| Whenever this ship would gain any amount of Heat, it loses 1 Serenity instead.
|-

| [[File:MaxShard.png|36x36px]]|| Max Shard|| Temporarily increases maximum shard count by X, and lasts until the end of combat.
|-

|-
| [[File:StunCharge.png|36x36px]]|| Stun Charge|| Applies [[Stun]] to the next X attacks. (Not consumed if the attack already has Stun by default). Goes away at the end of this ship's turn.

|-
| [[File:TableFlip.png|36x36px]]|| Table Flip|| Any card with directional actions becomes [[Card Traits#Flippable|flippable]].
|-
| [[File:TimeStop.png|36x36px]]|| Time Stop|| Other statuses will not decrease or reset over time (except for "Gain/Lose ___ Next Turn" statuses). [[Temporary Shield]] will also not reset. Decreases by 1 at the start of the ship's turn.
